snippet.title: Murder Mystery Mayhem AI - Streamer Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3220670/Murder_Mystery_Mayhem_AI/
Find the murderer in this AI-powered 1920s whodunit. Interrogate suspects with rich personalities and piece together clues in procedurally generated cases. Experience infinite replayability as you roleplay a detective in this unique blend of deduction, strategy, and AI-driven storytelling.
